name: stride
description: Local-first, deterministic multi-sport training analytics. The engine computes the numbers; the agent adds judgment.

interface.shortDescription: Coach training from local Strava data
interface.longDescription: Stride syncs Strava data into a local SQLite database and computes training-science metrics deterministically — CTL/ATL/TSB, zone distribution, decoupling, W' balance, critical power. The agent reads the JSON and coaches; it never does the math itself.
defaultPrompt: How is my training load trending?
Plan my week from my recent sessions.
Which sessions were unusually hard for me?
